title: Josephine Baker's birth chart
metaDescription: Josephine Baker's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 12.2° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Gemini — the Sun, Mercury, Mars, Jupiter and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 12.2° Gemini: the second decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Venus. A air sign, read here in its second face.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 5.9° Gemini; Venus stands at 9.7° Cancer; Mars stands at 24.6° Gemini. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste tuned to mood and undertow from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Neptune — a conjunction holding at 0.6°. The tradition stops reading a conjunction as two things. It is one appetite with two names, and it moves together or not at all. Behind it, Uranus opposition Neptune at 1.6°, and Venus opposition Uranus at 2.2° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mercury in Gemini at 5.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Gemini at 17.2° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 5, water 3, earth 1; modalities mutable 6, cardinal 3. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Uranus was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Libra into Scorpio during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.8° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
